name: Vampire: Who Killed Me?
source:
A visual novel mystery about a vampire who was turned against their will and wants to find out who turned them.

[From [url=https://illusia.itch.io/vampire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部悬疑视觉小说，讲述了一个吸血鬼在违背自己意愿的情况下被背叛，并想找出是谁背叛了他们。

[来自[url=https://illusia.itch.io/vampire]itch.io[/url]]
